objective: Preserve every matter cluster surfaced by corpus-wide semantic discovery until it receives source follow-up, and give the agent one bounded chance to close abandoned candidates or deferred reads before finishing.

changes.failure_pattern: Complete semantic searches repeatedly surfaced responsive matter clusters, but the agent sampled a preferred subset, lost zero-follow-up clusters across turns, and abandoned exact reads that returned deferred with no text.
changes.mechanism: After the direct matter census activates corpus mode, retain matter clusters from semantic glob and grep results until a later read reaches that cluster, retain exact zero-text deferred paths until successful progress, and place both queues in one replaceable bounded framework reminder even after discovery pagination is complete.
changes.rationale: The earliest shared failure occurs between successful discovery and candidate-specific reading. The retained middleware already owns cross-turn coverage state but tracked only incomplete pages and partial ranges, so improving that state machine is smaller and more reliable than another general prompt reminder.

changes.failure_pattern: A non-blocking coverage reminder was visible but corpus-wide runs still finished while discovered clusters had no follow-up and exact candidate reads remained deferred with zero text.
changes.mechanism: For activated corpus-mode state only, reject the first finish attempt when zero-follow-up clusters or deferred exact reads remain, name a bounded set of gaps, and allow a later retry regardless so heuristic false positives cannot create a stop loop.
changes.rationale: Finish is the strongest reusable point at which an otherwise ignored closure warning can create one repair opportunity. The one-rejection cap preserves legitimate completion when a lexical hit is incidental and leaves existing missing-deliverable checks intact.

evidence: debugger/tasks/task-d2b75f462ef0358fc682/result.json: bounded recovery required for deferred candidate reads
changes.failure_pattern: The model could not anticipate or correctly recover from a candidate-aware finish rejection because the prior finish schema described only generic completion.
changes.mechanism: Describe both capped checks, the meaning of a candidate-closure rejection, the required ledger reconciliation, and the safe retry behavior at the point of tool use.
changes.rationale: The API tool description is the authoritative model-facing contract for the changed finish implementation and prevents a bounded rejection from being mistaken for a terminal error.

evidence: debugger/tasks/task-42dd3f8d28ed3542bb79/result.json: ledger created only after selective drafting
changes.failure_pattern: Agents treated semantic hits as examples rather than a queue and sometimes copied the exhaustive internal research set into a singular user-facing answer.
changes.mechanism: Require immediate ledger promotion of every distinct semantic-hit cluster, exact later-turn recovery for deferred reads, and an explicit separation between exhaustive internal reconciliation and the cardinality of the requested final answer.
changes.rationale: Middleware can preserve candidate state but cannot decide legal relevance or requested answer cardinality; the prompt defines those semantic transitions while the deterministic components enforce only observable coverage invariants.
